format:

params:

---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(tidygraph)

#' Read the distance matrix of `wgMLST distance` (first line: the number of strains, then one row per strain)
#'
#' @param f the distance file
#' @return a numeric matrix, its rows and columns named by the genomes
read_pymlst_distance <- function(f) {
	m <- read_tsv(f, skip = 1, col_names = FALSE, col_types = cols(X1 = "c", .default = "d")) %>%
	  column_to_rownames("X1") %>%
	  as.matrix()
	colnames(m) <- rownames(m)
	m
}

#' Remove the prefix common to all the names, cut after its last separator (`:`, `.`, `_`, `-`, `/` or space) so that
#' no name is cut inside a word
#'
#' @param names a character vector
#' @return the names without their common prefix (unchanged when they have none, or when there is a single name)
remove_common_prefix <- function(names) {
	if (n_distinct(names) < 2) return(names)
	prefix <- str_extract(Biobase::lcPrefix(unique(names)), "^.*[:._/ -]")
	if (is.na(prefix)) return(names)
	str_sub(names, str_length(prefix) + 1)
}

#' Axis of categories (genome or gene names, without their common prefix), the labels truncated on the left: long names (wider than the plot when it is drawn in a hidden
#' dashboard page) make plotly fail with "Something went wrong with axis scaling", which also stops the next widgets
#'
#' @param names the names of the categories of the axis
#' @param ... other properties of the axis
#' @return a plotly axis definition
names_axis <- function(names, ...) {
	list(tickvals = names, ticktext = str_trunc(names, 25, side = "left"), ...)
}

```


```{r data}
#| include: false
dist_mat <- read_pymlst_distance(fs::path(params$input_dir, "pymlst/distance.tsv"))
if (nrow(dist_mat) > 2) {
	dist_mat <- dist_mat[hclust(as.dist(dist_mat), method = "ward.D2")$order,]
	dist_mat <- dist_mat[,rownames(dist_mat)]
}
dimnames(dist_mat) <- map(dimnames(dist_mat), remove_common_prefix)    # the same genomes in rows and columns

genes <- read_tsv(
  fs::path(params$input_dir, "core_genes.tsv"),
  col_types = cols(genome = "c", is_core_template = "l", .default = "c")
)

alleles <- read_tsv(fs::path(params$input_dir, "pymlst/mlst.tsv"), col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
	rename(gene_uid = 1) |>
	pivot_longer(-gene_uid, names_to = "genome", values_to = "allele") |>
	group_by(gene_uid) |>
	mutate(rank = match(allele, names(sort(table(allele), decreasing = TRUE)))) |>    # NA for a missing gene
	ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    gene_uid = as_factor(remove_common_prefix(gene_uid)),
    genome = fct_relevel(remove_common_prefix(genome), rownames(dist_mat))    # the genomes of dist_mat, the same prefix removed
  )
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Genes of each genome"
genes |>
	group_by(Genome = genome) |>
	summarise(Genes = n(), `Core template genes` = sum(is_core_template)) |>
	knitr::kable()
```

::: {.card title="About"}
`r nrow(dist_mat)` genomes, typed with pyMLST (wgMLST) on their core genes: the clusters of genes found in at least
`r params$n_core` genomes.

- **Genes**: the genes of the clusters of reciprocal BLASTN hits (one gene per genome in each cluster).
- **Core template genes**: one gene per core cluster, the template of the pyMLST database; counted in the genome of the
  gene.
- The genomes are named by their id.
:::

# Distances

## Row

```{r distance_heatmap}
#| title: "Distance matrix: number of core genes with different alleles (genomes ordered by a Ward clustering)"
plot_ly(
	x = colnames(dist_mat), y = rownames(dist_mat), z = dist_mat, type = "heatmap",
	colorscale = "YlOrRd", reversescale = TRUE, colorbar = list(title = "Distance"),
	text = array(
	  sprintf("%s - %s<br>distance: %s", rownames(dist_mat)[row(dist_mat)], colnames(dist_mat)[col(dist_mat)],dist_mat),
	  dim(dist_mat)
	),
	hoverinfo = "text",
	texttemplate = "%{z}"    # the distance in each cell
) |>
	layout(
		xaxis = names_axis(colnames(dist_mat), title = "", tickangle = 90),
		yaxis = names_axis(rownames(dist_mat), title = "", autorange = "reversed", scaleanchor = "x")    # square cells
	)
```

```{r mst}
#| title: "Minimum spanning tree of the pyMLST distances: the genomes at distance 0 merged into a single node (hover a node for its genomes; edges labelled by the distance)"
# a distance of 0 (identical genomes) would be no edge in the adjacency graph: add a tiny weight to all the edges
g <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(dist_mat+1, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE, diag = TRUE) %>%
  as_tbl_graph() %>%
  activate(edges) %>%
  mutate(weight = weight-1) %>%
  activate(nodes)
mst_g <- g %>%
  convert(to_minimum_spanning_tree, weights = weight)

# the groups of genomes linked by edges of distance 0 contracted into a single node (the edges of distance 0 become
# loops, removed)
mst_simple <- mst_g |>
	morph(to_subgraph, weight == 0, subset_by = "edges") |>
	mutate(group = group_components()) |>
	unmorph() |>
	convert(to_contracted, group, simplify = FALSE) |>
	activate(edges) |>
	filter(weight != 0)

# interactive display
nodes <- as_tibble(mst_simple, "nodes") |>
	transmute(
		id = row_number(),
		n = map_int(.orig_data, nrow),
		label = if_else(n == 1, map_chr(.orig_data, \(d) d$name[1]), str_c(n, " genomes")),
		title = map_chr(.orig_data, \(d) str_c(
			str_c(nrow(d), if_else(nrow(d) == 1, " genome", " genomes")),
			split(d$name, ceiling(seq_along(d$name) / 4)) |> map_chr(\(x) str_c(x, collapse = ", ")) |> str_c(collapse = "<br>"),    # 4 names per line
			sep = "<br>"
		)),
		size = 10 + 5 * sqrt(n)    # grows with the number of genomes
	)
edges <- as_tibble(mst_simple, "edges") |>
	transmute(
		from, to,
		label = as.character(weight),
		title = str_c(nodes$label[from], " - ", nodes$label[to], ": ", weight),
		length = 50 + 300 * weight / max(1, weight)
	)
visNetwork::visNetwork(nodes, edges, width = "100%") |>
	visNetwork::visNodes(shape = "dot", color = "steelblue") |>
	visNetwork::visEdges(color = "grey", font = list(align = "middle")) |>
	visNetwork::visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE) |>
	visNetwork::visInteraction(navigationButtons = TRUE)
```

# Alleles

```{r allele_heatmap}
#| title: "Allele of each core gene in each genome: alleles numbered by decreasing frequency in each gene (1: the most frequent), white for a missing gene; hover a cell for its pyMLST allele id"

local({
  z_mat <- alleles %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols=genome,names_from = gene_uid,values_from = rank) %>%
    column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
    as.matrix()
  text_mat <- alleles %>%
    mutate(text = sprintf("gene: %s<br>genome: %s<br>allele: %s", gene_uid, genome, replace_na(allele, "missing"))) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols=genome,names_from = gene_uid,values_from = text) %>%
    column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
    as.matrix()
  plot_ly(
  	x = colnames(z_mat), y = rownames(z_mat), z = z_mat, text = text_mat, hoverinfo = "text",
  	type = "heatmap", colorscale = "Viridis", colorbar = list(title = "Allele rank")
  ) |>
  	layout(
  		xaxis = names_axis(colnames(z_mat), title = "Core gene", showticklabels = ncol(z_mat) <= 100),
  		yaxis = names_axis(rownames(z_mat), title = "", autorange = "reversed")
  	)
})
```
